sloka: लक्षणज्ञो निरीक्ष्यैव रावणं चैवमब्रवीत् ।गृहस्थैषां हि सुश्रोणी त्वद्वधायैव दृश्यते ।। ७.१७.३७ ॥
transliteration: lakṣaṇajño nirīkṣyaiva rāvaṇaṁ caivamabravīt ।gṛhasthaiṣāṁ hi suśroṇī tvadvadhāyaiva dṛśyate ।। 7.17.37 ॥

translations.english: Having seized the maiden, who shone like the heart of a lotus, the demon went to his own house, and Ravana then showed her to his minister.
